decision_rule: STOP if candidate_count == 0 or max(1 - P(gain_0)) < threshold
selection_rule: Maximize STOP F1; then minimize conditional premature stopping; then maximize accuracy; then smaller threshold.
proxy_note: 1 - max P(gain>0) is a diagnostic score, not a calibrated joint probability of answer-set completeness.
answer_recognition: Oracle during offline state generation; online learned-recognition evaluation is still required.
